sections.title: Basic Concept
sections.content: In Time & Work, the fundamental idea is the relationship between the total time required to complete a task and the worker's efficiency. If a person can complete a task in X days, their work done per day (efficiency) = 1/X of the total work.

sections.title: Work Rate
sections.content:
Work rate = 1 / total days
Example: Mohan can complete a task in 5 days, so his work rate = 1/5 per day. This means he completes 1/5 of the work each day.

sections.title: Combined Work
sections.content:
If two people work together, combined work rate = rate of person 1 + rate of person 2.
Example: Mohan rate = 1/5, Sohan rate = 1/10, Combined rate = 1/5 + 1/10 = 3/10 per day. Time to complete = 10/3 ≈ 3.33 days.

sections.title: Work-Time Relationship
sections.content:
Time ∝ Work / Work Rate
Example: If work doubles and rate is same, time also doubles. If work is halved, time halves.

sections.title: Fractional Work
sections.content:
If a fraction of work is done initially, remaining time = remaining work ÷ combined rate.
Example: Total work = 1, first day 1/4 done, rate = 1/2 per day, time for remaining = (1-1/4)/(1/2) = 1.5 days.

sections.title: Important Formulas
sections.content:
1. Work rate = 1 / total days
2. Time = Total work ÷ work rate
3. Combined work rate = sum of individual rates
4. Time for fractional work = remaining ÷ rate

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content:
• Confusing time and work
• Incorrectly adding rates for combined work
• Forgetting to subtract already completed work
• Using wrong fraction for partial work

sections.title: Quick Summary
sections.content:
• Efficiency = 1/Time
• Combined work: add all rates
• Fractional work: remaining ÷ rate
• Time ∝ Work / Rate

tricks.title: Simple Rate Addition
tricks.explanation: Add all workers' rates, then total work ÷ combined rate = total time

tricks.title: Partial Work Days
tricks.explanation: Subtract fraction of work done, then divide by rate to get remaining days
tricks.example: 1/4 work done, rate=1/2/day, Remaining time=(1-1/4)/(1/2)=1.5 days

tricks.title: Equal Rate Workers
tricks.explanation: If N workers have equal rate, Time = original time ÷ N
tricks.example: Mohan 6 days, 3 equal workers, Time=6/3=2 days

tricks.title: Two Different Rates
tricks.explanation: Add different rates, then Total ÷ combined rate

tricks.title: Efficiency-Time Relation
tricks.explanation: Work rate ↑ → time ↓, Work rate ↓ → time ↑
tricks.example: Worker twice as fast → time halved

tricks.title: Work Percentage
tricks.explanation: Percentage of work done = (work done ÷ total work) × 100
